action.action-desc: Mr. McClintock introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Natural Resources

form.official-title: To codify Secretary’s Order 3434 of the Department of the Interior.

section.text: Secretary’s Order 3434 issued by the Secretary of the Interior and dated June 25, 2025 (relating to strengthening coordination with gateway communities), shall have the force and effect of law.
